answer: A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The glacier counter is kept in forge and crystal publishes each reset. An adversary thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1120 identities would post 849 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
